title: Human embryonic gonad dissociation with Collagenase & Trypsin
author: Carmen Sancho
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bwcipaue
materials: Tighten lid and then seal with parafilm.
Proceed to cell count with disposable C-chip haematocytometer.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate FBS
steps.instruction: Place fetal bovine serum (FBS) in a water bath at 56 °C for 30 minutes to inactivate it before use.

steps.title: Wash tissue with PBS
steps.instruction: Rinse the human embryonic gonad tissue thoroughly with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS).

steps.title: Mince tissue with scalpels
steps.instruction: Lay the wet tissue on a petri dish, use two scalpels to roughly mince it into small pieces to improve digestion efficiency.

steps.title: Transfer tissue to collagenase mix
steps.instruction: Move the minced tissue into a 15 mL Falcon tube containing the prepared collagenase mix (approximately 10 mL per tissue piece, volume may vary with tissue size).

steps.title: Incubate digestion with shaking
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 45 minutes, gently shaking the tube every 10 minutes during the incubation.

steps.title: Filter through 100 µm strainer
steps.instruction: Pass the digested suspension through a 100 µm cell strainer and retain the filter for later use.

steps.title: Centrifuge first pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the filtered suspension at 450 g (≈0.5 rcf) for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Decant supernatant, leave residual
steps.instruction: Carefully decant about 90 % of the supernatant, leaving between 0.5 mL and 1 mL of liquid in the tube.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet and filter
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL PBS, pass the suspension through the inverted 100 µm filter, then add an additional 3 mL PBS.

substeps.instruction: Pass suspension through the inverted filter

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension again at 450 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Decant and transfer to 1 mL tube
steps.instruction: Decant about 90 % of the supernatant, leaving 0.5–1 mL, and transfer the remaining volume to a 1 mL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to a 1 mL Eppendorf tube

steps.title: Third centrifugation and discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 450 g for 5 minutes (4 °C) and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Add trypsin‑EDTA/DNase I and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of Trypsin‑EDTA/DNase I to the pellet, then incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes with rotation.

steps.title: Add RPMI complete and filter
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of complete RPMI medium, then filter the mixture through a FACS tube while passing an additional 1 mL of RPMI medium.

steps.title: Transfer to 5 mL tube and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Move the filtered suspension to a 5 mL Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 450 g for 5 minutes (4 °C).

steps.title: Resuspend in PBS‑BSA and transfer
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet, resuspend the cells in 1 mL PBS‑BSA 0.04 %, and transfer the suspension to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer to a 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube

steps.title: Final centrifugation and leave volume
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 450 g for 5 minutes (4 °C) and retain 200–300 µL of the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 450 g for 5 minutes at 4 °C
